figurative_meaning_bn: অনর্গলভাবে কথা বলা; অনবরত বকবক করা
figurative_meaning_en: Speaking fluently without pause; chattering continuously
example_sentences_in_bangla: তার মুখে খই ফোটা, থামতেই চায় না।
প্রদীপের মুখে যেন খই ফুটছে, সারাদিন বকবক করে।
example_sentences_in_english: He's chattering away non-stop, like puffed rice popping in his mouth.
Her mouth is full of popping puffed rice; she won't stop talking all day.
note: The idiom draws from the imagery of puffed rice (khoi) expanding and popping when heated, symbolizing uncontrollable verbal flow in Bengali folklore.
